'''Pelkan's Mansion''' was located on [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. [[Mosh Pelkan]] lived a life of luxury and his Mansion matched this. It was a round penthouse that towered over the surrounding area of [[Gralleenya]], Questal's capital city.
